R1.evidence: agent->gateway HTTP works (gcx via http://gauge) and gateway reaches healthy under `docker compose -p gaugeaudit -f examples/task-pack-compose/docker-compose.yaml up`; BUT no tests/test.sh and no solution/solve.sh exist in the repo, so nop=0/oracle=1 cannot be measured (R1.3 unsatisfiable).

R2.evidence: `docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/abundant-ai/gauge-service:{prod-v1,empty}` -> ABSENT (R2.b fail); no baked-DB Dockerfile, only empty-image + mounted state.json (R2.j fail); GHCR :main is amd64-only and the agent ships the full gauge/server API source with `import gauge.server.state` succeeding (R2.k partial).

R3.evidence: Live MCP stdio client listed 24 tools; `search_dashboards{query:'payment'}` returns byte-identical record to `gcx dashboards search payment --json`; both are thin clients of one HTTP API (gauge.cli.client). `--disable-write` filters create_annotation.

R4.evidence: ~19 capabilities enumerated by calling each; every CLI group + 24 MCP tools map to real /api/* endpoints with Grafana-shaped envelopes (verified whoami, search, ds/query PromQL+LogQL, alert-instances, annotations). Behavioral coverage complete; docs/COVERAGE.md is missing (advisory action item).

R5.evidence: >=6 assessment-grade capabilities (PromQL query grammar, LogQL query grammar, alert-instances list+filter, panel-query exec, annotation create write->read RT, label-values multi-step); annotation create RT exercised end-to-end (create id:1 -> list reads back -> gaugectl mutations shows annotation.create); realistic errors (exit 2 / isError / JSON-RPC -32602).

R6.evidence: `pytest -q` => 26 passed from clean install; broad endpoint/CLI/MCP smoke incl MCP error path (-32602). Missing: no in-process parity test (R6.2 CLI==MCP) and no importable-generator isolation test (R6.3 `import gauge.server.state` raises). Docker isolation assertions exist only in test_task_pack_compose, which is gated off unless GAUGE_RUN_DOCKER_SMOKE=1, and they check only file/gaugectl absence, not the importable leak.

R7.evidence: audit/audit-report.md and audit/audit-verdict.json emitted per _shared schemas with per-requirement results, evidence, and ordered file-scoped action items.
